newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Mayne still sees Optus float this yr.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Mayne still sees Optus float this yr.

text.p: Mayne Nickless Ltd said on Friday it reaffirmed its commitment to float Optus Communications Pty Ltd in calendar 1996.
"We are actively pursuing strategies with the other shareholders in Optus to achieve a float of Optus this calendar year," Mayne Nickless managing director Bob Dalziel said.
"Whichever float strategy is pursued we will honour our previous commitment to Mayne Nickless shareholders that they will receive a large entitlement in the float," Dalziel said.
"We will immediately inform Mayne Nickless shareholders in the event that the float is not achievable in calendar 1996."
Mayne shares were three cents lower at A$8.25 at 1.25 p.m. (0325 GMT) after reaching a day's low of A$8.05.
Company spokesman Karl Kitchen said he could not reveal the range of float strategies being considered by Mayne and its other shareholders, which include BellSouth Corp and Cable and Wireless Plc
"We are looking at alternative strategies. They have to be discussed with the other shareholders," Kitchen told Reuters.
"I don't think we would have put out the statement if we were not confident that a float of Optus could be achieved this year," he said. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
